The system's design ensures that all content and briefs are routed through free lanes, while quality surfaces remain on Claude clouds. This dual policy prevents unintended spending and maintains compliance. The router's architecture avoids unnecessary latency by eliminating extra gateway hops, ensuring single-deploy efficiency. Misconfiguration leads to explicit failures rather than silent errors, maintaining system integrity. The core logic is a state machine transitioning between free and paid lanes based on input type and credit availability.
